@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8680'
+title: 'Tool-call telemetry: limit the outcome dimension, make a timeout not an error, keep the session tracer in nested mounts, and stop the timer with the span'
+---
+## What
+
+The existing tool telemetry has four problems.
+
+(a) The outcome dimension has no limit. `OperationOutcome.other(String)` (`Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/OperationEvents/OperationOutcome.swift:52`) gives its text from `rawValue` (`:67-74`, the `.other` branch is `:68-70`). That text goes as is into the `tool.outcome` metric dimension (`ExtrasTelemetry.toolCallDimensions`, `Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/Telemetry/ExtrasTelemetry.swift:199-203`) and into the span attribute (`Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/Hosting/ToolCallSpan.swift:104`). A tool supplies that text, so the cardinality has no limit and the text can leak content. Add one telemetry value of an outcome in `ExtrasTelemetry` that maps each `.other` to the fixed value `other`, and use it for the dimension and for the span attribute. Do not change `rawValue`, because it is the wire format.
+
+(b) A timeout is recorded as an error. `RunToCompletionRunner.callToCompletion(arguments:)` (`Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/Hosting/RunToCompletionRunner.swift:34`) says at `:28` that a timeout is not a failure. But `settlement.result.get()` (`:48`) throws `ToolMountError.timedOut`, and `TracedCall` gives the span the error status. A timeout must record `tool.outcome=timed_out` and no error status. The model must still get the same thrown `ToolMountError.timedOut`. Each other error keeps the error status.
+
+(c) A nested mount loses the tracer. `ToolContext.mount(_:op:as:)` (`Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/Hosting/ToolContext.swift:345`) and `mount(_:op:as:postingTo:)` (`:383`) make a `MountSite` with `tracer: nil`. Thus an inner call uses `InstrumentationSystem.tracer`, and ignores the tracer that the host gave to `MountSite` (`Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/Hosting/ToolMounting.swift:66`). `ToolContext` keeps no tracer now. Keep `site.tracer` in `ToolContext` when it is made (`ToolRun.swift:54`, `ContextBindingTool.swift:55`), and pass it at `:345` and `:383`.
+
+(d) The timer and the span measure different intervals. In `ContextBindingTool.call(arguments:)` (`Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/Hosting/ContextBindingTool.swift:37`), `ToolCallSpan.record(outcome:on:)` (`:42`) stops the duration before `postToolCallReport` (`:43`), but the span includes the report. Make the timer and the span measure the same interval: record the outcome and the duration after the report, or end the span at the same point.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A tool outcome `.other("anything")` gives `tool.outcome=other` on the metric dimension and on the span attribute. The wire `rawValue` does not change.
+- [ ] A run-to-completion call that times out records `tool.outcome=timed_out`, has no error status and no `error.type` on its span, and still throws `ToolMountError.timedOut`.
+- [ ] A tool that `ToolContext.mount` mounts uses the tracer of the session, for both `mount` overloads.
+- [ ] In `ContextBindingTool`, the recorded duration covers the same interval as the span, with the report included.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsExtrasTests/Hosting/ToolCallSpanTests.swift`: a test for each of (a), (b) and (d), with `W3CInMemoryTracer` and `MetricsTestKit` `TestMetrics`.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsExtrasTests/Telemetry/ExtrasTelemetryTests.swift`: the telemetry value of each `OperationOutcome` case, and `.other` gives `other`.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsExtrasTests/Hosting/ToolContextTests.swift`: an inner call of a mounted tool records its span on the tracer of the host `MountSite`, for both overloads.
+- [ ] A content-safety test with `TelemetryCapture.run(forbidding:)` that forbids the `.other` text.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes with no warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
+
+#telemetry #bug
\ No newline at end of file
